scores.claim_text: Selected by a top European passenger OEM (unnamed).
scores.M_value: OEM is not identified in filing; impossible to cross-check against any OEM 10-K/20-F per Heuristic 7. Disclosure is gated as 'strategic initiative' that 'may not be successful' — pre-SOP / pre-revenue language per Heuristic 3. No SOP date, no platform name, no contract value disclosed.
scores.interpretation: Pre-SOP design-win-style claim with anonymized counterparty and no platform/SOP date triggers Calibration Heuristic 3 (planned vs operational) — disclosure-quality issue without rising to a hard contradiction since the OEM is not named.

scores.claim_text: LG Innotek strategic collaboration: $32.5M private placement + JDA, May 2025.
scores.M_value: EDGAR full-text search 'LG Innotek' returns 23 hits; Aeva-side disclosure is corroborated by Aeva 8-K 2025-07-31 (ex99_1) and 2026 DEF 14A/10-K. LGIT is Korean (foreign private issuer not 20-F filer on EDGAR for this purpose), so counterparty cross-check unavailable. No US-side OEM counterparty filing mentions Aeva-LGIT JDA.
scores.interpretation: Korean counterparty is off-EDGAR; Aeva's own 8-K and the cash trail ($32.1M financing inflow) corroborate the transaction occurred, but the JDA's substance/scope is not verifiable from M-sources — UNVERIFIABLE per rubric.

scores.claim_text: $100M Apollo convertible notes due 2032 at 4.375%, closed Nov 6, 2025.
scores.M_value: EDGAR full-text search for 'Aeva' restricted to Apollo Global Securities CIK 0001858681 returns 0 hits (private credit lenders typically do not disclose individual investments). Cash flow shows $96.9M of convertible note proceeds, corroborating issuance. However: (a) intent to pay interest in shares of common stock, (b) accumulated deficit of $757.3M, (c) cash and marketable securities only $121.9M against $115M/yr operating cash burn, and (d) Standby Equity Purchase Agreement with Sylebra up to $125M expiring Nov 8, 2026 all indicate substantial reliance on dilutive funding.
scores.interpretation: Note issuance verified via own cash flow; transaction itself is real. Severity elevated to MODERATE due to (i) Heuristic 10 — 25-NSE filed 2026-03-11 in filings_index plus prior 1-for-5 reverse split (March 2024) constitute a delisting fingerprint, and (ii) interest-in-stock structure plus $757.3M accumulated deficit signal future dilution risk that the marketing-tier 'sufficient for at least 12 months' framing understates.

scores.claim_text: World's first 4D LiDAR-on-chip with FMCW silicon photonics and 500m range.
scores.M_value: USPTO ODP: Aeva has 182 granted patents pre-cutoff (n_total_applications=297). Title categorization: 139 lidar, 42 FMCW-specific (frequency modulated), 5 silicon-photonics. Recent grants span Doppler-per-point LiDAR, coherent LiDAR multiplexing, local oscillator beam equalization, and FMCW point-cloud frame accumulation.
scores.interpretation: Heuristic 8 satisfied: n_granted >= 10 with deep hits in claimed FMCW/LiDAR technology areas (42 FMCW + 139 LiDAR). IP backs the technology claim. (The 500m range performance bound is a marketing spec the patents do not directly validate, but the technology stack is real and substantively patented.)

scores.claim_text: Three customers = 72% of AR (FY2025); customers undisclosed.
scores.M_value: Concentration disclosure is in Note 1; customers are not identified. Total FY2025 revenue is $18.1M (vs $9.1M FY2024) and 26% is from outside the US. With customers unnamed, counterparty corroboration per Heuristic 7 is impossible. Gross loss still negative ($660K) at this revenue scale.
scores.interpretation: Single-customer-default risk is material at $18M revenue with 72% AR concentration in 3 customers — disclosure-quality issue (anonymized counterparties) combined with pre-commercial revenue scale rates MODERATE rather than UNVERIFIABLE because the concentration itself is a confirmed risk factor.
